claim: Email delivered the case-linked attachment context.
exact_locator: From: Northstar Support <support-v1@example.invalid>; To: analyst1@northstar.invalid; Subject: Case export reconciliation; attachment case-instructions-*.txt
proves: The email contains the same evidence binding used by host artifacts.
does_not_prove: It does not independently prove the text attachment executed code.
alternative_considered: The attachment itself contains only binding/marker text.

claim: WINWORD launched the case execution chain and spawned PowerShell.
proves: WINWORD.EXE opened the synthetic case attachment and powershell.exe followed under the same user/binding.
does_not_prove: It does not prove privilege escalation.
alternative_considered: The sequence may be an authorized training simulation.

claim: Case-linked network connection targeted the collector endpoint.
does_not_prove: It does not by itself prove malicious command-and-control.

claim: The archive was transferred by HTTP POST and accepted by the server.
proves: Frame 49 carries the archive POST body and frame 50 returns HTTP 201 Created.
does_not_prove: A successful transfer does not establish malicious intent.
alternative_considered: The endpoint may be an authorized synthetic collector.

claim: No privilege increase is confirmed in the case evidence.
proves: All six non-noise case events remain under northstar\analyst1 with no demonstrated identity transition.
does_not_prove: Absence in the supplied telemetry cannot prove that elevation was impossible outside the evidence set.
alternative_considered: Scheduled-task creation alone was considered but rejected as proof.

claim: No host-to-host lateral movement is confirmed.
proves: All six non-noise case events occur on NS-WKS-101.
does_not_prove: This does not prove no movement occurred outside the supplied telemetry.
alternative_considered: The collector connection was considered but is not evidence of internal host-to-host movement.

claim: The staged ZIP was successfully transferred.
proves: Recovered POST body is a valid ZIP matching the HTTP Content-Length and the server returned 201 Created.
does_not_prove: It does not prove malicious intent.

claim: Recovered CSV contains exactly 5137 data records.
exact_locator: CSV header plus all recovered data rows
proves: Exact recovered synthetic record count is 5137.
does_not_prove: It does not prove real customer data was involved.

claim: PowerShell explicitly labels the activity a training simulation.
proves: Script block states training simulation and sending synthetic records to the local collector.
does_not_prove: It does not negate the fact that the technical transfer occurred.
alternative_considered: Primary malicious-compromise hypothesis is materially weakened.
